Hero_Desc_Shoupan:
A light-speed courier racing across Elias.
Enjoys riding the Shoupabolt, zipping from place to place.
While she's committed to quick deliveries, she couldn't care less about the safety of the items.
Album_Hate_Shoupan: Landlords who take forever to answer the door.
Album_Wish_Shoupan: Racing at the speed of light.
Album_Shoupan1: Shoupan is the cheerful courier of the Sprite Kingdom. From food delivery to mail and package shipments, Shoupan is said to be the fastest when it comes to getting items to customers.
Album_Shoupan2: When the elves first arrived in Elias, Shoupan served as a messenger between the Sprite Palace and the elven leadership. The two-wheeled vehicle Shoupan rides was a gift from the elves in recognition of those efforts.
Album_Shoupan3: Shoupan initially started out as a postal worker for the Sprite Kingdom simply because of a love for speed. Enjoying the sights of different locations, Shoupan eagerly takes on courier jobs for the Order, even those requiring travel to distant lands.
Album_Shoupan4: Merchants prefer to entrust their deliveries to Shoupan. The courier's swift service has earned a solid reputation. However, reliability is another story. Mayo frequently complains about getting into disputes with Shoupan.
Album_Shoupan5: Whenever Shoupan shows up at the Sprite Palace, the entire place goes on high alert. Erpin, in particular, seems to go out of her way to avoid Shoupan. Apparently, they've had multiple run-ins—literally—where Shoupan crashed into Erpin in the hallway. Though Erpin always walked away unscathed, Shoupan's bike ended up wrecked each time, leaving Erpin to foot the bill.
Album_Shoupan6: Shoupan has been submitting proposals to the Order for a tunnel construction project. The idea is to build a tunnel through Yggdrasil to make transportation more convenient. Every time Ner sees the proposal, she reacts in horror and immediately tears it up.
Album_Shoupan7: Shoupan dreams of traveling to a faraway place no one has ever been to before. She's bursting with excitement about what might lie beyond the borders of Elias... and suddenly, I find myself wondering the same thing.
LoveHeroCancel_Shoupan:
Tch! If you're going to use me
like a taxi,
at least pay the fare!
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Hate1: Shoupan grumbled that she could make two more deliveries in the time it takes for the soup to cool down.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Hate2: Expressing her disdain, Shoupan recalled a time she slipped on seaweed scattered along the riverside while running.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like1: With chocolate smeared all around her mouth, Shoupan devoured a portion in a frenzy. Seeing her obsession with sweets, she truly is a Sprite...
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like10: She liked it, saying that deliveries often make her miss meals and this would be helpful at such times. When she asked whether she could come take some whenever necessary, I told her not to break down the door.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like2: Shoupan gulped down rice cake soup, saying it was so delicious that she didn't mind burning the roof of her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like3: Shoupan cleaned out the inside of a Bûche de Noël, saying it made her want to race through it. She seemed to have a knack for such tasks.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like4: Shoupan praised it as the perfect quick meal for a busy modern Sprite. It seems her delivery work is quite demanding.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like5: She declared that Sour Vita F was the most perfect portable snack.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like6: Excitedly comparing it to a traffic light, Shoupan pretended to drive and played around.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like7: Shoupan made an enigmatic comment, saying that her life is bittersweet when stopped and sweet when running, just like the food.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like8: Shoupan ordered a large quantity, saying the refreshing taste banished her drowsiness, and smiled brightly, saying she wouldn't have to worry about drowsy driving anymore.
Food_ChefNote_Shoupan_Like9: Shoupan said the assortment of flavored candies reminded her of her magical bag. Watching her play with it for a long time, it seemed she liked it a lot.

LoveCall_Shoupan:
Master! I left a package on the shelf in your room earlier. Did you see it?
I delivered it especially gently, so do not worry about the contents~

Whew~ I have been so busy lately. Ten bodies would still not be enough.
Which reminds me, would you not like a two-wheel-drive speed machine too, Master?
Shall I ask the Elves to build one? We could name it the 'Master Bolt'! How does that sound?
Riding side by side down the road would feel incredible! Haha!

I am absolutely not trying to make you deliver packages in my place, understood? I am not such a bad Sprite, so do not misunderstand!
Thanks to you, I can work comfortably as a freelancer. I simply want to repay you~

Anyway, I need to resume my deliveries, so I am hanging up! I will call again! Bye-bye!

Affinity_Shoupan_EP01_002: Thanks for all the hard work keeping deliveries speedy.

Affinity_Shoupan_EP08_002: Hey! Don't charge into the wall!
